outcome: Successful removal of cesarean scar pregnancy
Complete repair of uterine scar defect
cohort: 8 women with type 2 cesarean scar pregnancy at a gestational age >8 weeks
finding: Hysteroscopy-assisted laparoscopy was an effective treatment for patients with type 2 cesarean scar pregnancy at gestational age >8 weeks, with complete removal of the pregnancy, repair of the uterine scar defect, and no recurrences at long-term follow-up.
